question: Which company has been recognized among India's Top 50 Best Workplaces in Manufacturing 2025 by Great Place to Work?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Coal India Limited**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Coal India Limited (CIL) recognized among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Manufacturing 2025 by Great Place to Work.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Selected from 347 manufacturing organizations, highlighting its commitment to employee welfare and workplace excellence.**
 
• **CIL, a Maharatna PSU under the Ministry of Coal, is the world's largest coal producer, fulfilling 80% of India's coal demand.**
 
• **Previously awarded the ‘Great Place to Work’ certification for fostering an inclusive and sustainable work environment.**
